faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate - I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate - I position at IIT Gandhinagar is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a four-year Bachelor's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences, a Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences, BVSc, B.Pharm, or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, or Medicine from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the official notification states that there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate - I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 39,000/- to Rs. 48,100/- per month, depending on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate - I position at IIT Gandhinagar through this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate - I recruitment is entirely online. Candidates must apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Project Associate - I role?
faq.answer: The primary stage of the selection process mentioned in the notification is Application Screening. Further stages, if any, will be communicated by the institute.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is SPON/10388/Advt0320 DATED 17.09.2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar. The terms and duration of the contract will be as per the institute's policy.
